consent_note: Role-played transcript for local development. No real clients. No real meeting took place and no real people are quoted.
title: Lakeside Makers Guild — search, filters, and mobile

turns.text: This is a scoping conversation for the Lakeside Makers Guild public directory. Priya, tell me what members struggle with today.
We are a small guild, about one hundred and eighty makers. The site is a membership directory. People come to find a ceramicist or a woodworker near them, and the search fights them.
When you say the search fights them, is the problem the words they type, the filters, or what they see on a phone?

All three, but I want to separate what might already be a setting from what is new. I have seen a search settings screen. I think city and member category can be turned on there. Those two are must-haves.
I will check whether city and category are existing search settings before anyone writes custom code. If they are settings, the work is configuration, not a new feature.
Please do not add a map to the search results. Members told us a map makes the page harder to use.

We do need a filter for craft type. Ceramic, wood, textile, metal. Category might already cover that. If it does, use the existing category filter. If it does not, tell me before you build something new.
A filter for members who offer workshops would be nice. I am not sure it is worth it. Call that a low priority until I confirm.
On my phone the directory feels dated. I do not have a design in mind. I just know it feels old. I am not asking for a rebrand.
Jordan Hale joining. I chair the board. I have been listening. The phone problem is worse than the look.
When I open filters on my phone, the panel covers the results. I cannot see the members until I close it. The results have to stay visible while the filters are open.
Yes. That is the mobile behavior we want. The filter controls are also too small to tap. I have to zoom.
I am treating visible results and larger tap targets as the mobile work. The dated feeling stays a separate, unclear visual note, not a redesign.
Agreed. Maybe also a filter for years in business. I am not sure we need it, and we do not collect that field on the member profile today, so it may be impossible until the profile changes.
People expect this to work like the big directories they already use. I cannot name a feature from that. It is a feeling, not a requirement.
Decision: search and filters come before any visual refresh. We will not pay for a new look until search works.
Restating the must-haves: members can narrow the directory by city and by category, using existing settings if those settings already do it.
Yes. City and category are confirmed. Craft type should ride on category if that is the same data. Do not invent a second taxonomy.
Workshops stay optional. Do not start that filter unless I confirm it in writing.
The mobile rule is confirmed. Search results stay on screen while filters are open, on a phone, and the controls can be tapped without zooming.
Another decision: the homepage redesign is out of this project. Do not quote it and do not sneak it into the search work.
Homepage redesign is out of scope. I will also not promise a delivery date in the proposal.
Our member showcase is on April 18. People keep asking if the directory will feel usable before that event. That is our hope, not your promise.
I will record April 18 as your event, not as a date we commit to. If a change needs custom code, we stop and tell you before building it.
Good. We do not have a large budget. I am not giving you a number today. Show hours, and we will talk about money after we see the scope.
I need to correct the map. The board wants a map on the search results. That is a yes from the board.
That conflicts with what I said. Please do not add a map. I do not agree with the board on this, and I do not want us to pretend it is decided.
Then the map stays unresolved. We will not treat a map as a confirmed requirement and we will not treat the refusal as final either.
Could we filter by the language a member speaks? Several members teach in Spanish and English.
I have not decided on language. Leave it as a question. We might already store language on the profile, and I do not want a new field if we do.

Open items I am writing down: the map disagreement, whether workshops are in, whether years in business is even possible, and whether language is wanted. Confirmed work is city, category without a second craft taxonomy, and the two mobile behaviors.
That matches what I want. Please bring back what the platform already does before you estimate custom work. A missing note in the docs is not the same as the feature being absent.
Understood. Next step is a written scope with hours only, open questions listed, and no delivery date from us.
